text: start: Milton preparing the IRB packet

Verifier: irb-packet.md has consent form (3.1-3.4), debrief scripts (4.1-4.4), adverse-event levels/stop rules/records (5.1-5.5); summary 109 words; no 'feel/know what ADHD is like' claim; nothing sent; numbers trace to V03/V04/V15 or are marked placeholder/proposal/unverified

Verifier web spot-check: Nario-Redmond 2017 N=60/N=50, more confusion/helplessness/pity/discomfort, no attitude gain: confirmed (search summaries; PubMed blocked). GDPR Art.33 72h breach notice: confirmed, correctly flagged conditional
